title: A combined rotate-and-translate line whose envelope (either direction) leaves the panel
rationale: Rotate-in-place lines are not verified (gate rotate_in_place_ok closed), so links use the disclosed combined profile, one G00 X Y C line (safety-model 9.1). From (1200, 600) at C = 0 to (1250, 410) at C = 60, the envelope conv({p_a, p_b} + arc_k) + rho of the rear wheel (safety-model 9.4) contains the pose 'translated first, rotated last', with the rear wheel at (1250, 8): it leaves the panel, in either turning direction. Refused, never warned (E-C12). The other wheels stay clear of cut a in both turning directions of the same amount; a reading that takes the complementary arc as the other direction also finds W-SURF (the same check id W-RAPID).
